FEAT-4-STORY-13.title: Implement NPI Registry API Client and Data Mapping
FEAT-4-STORY-13.description: Build core logic to call CMS NPI Registry API and map response fields into the standardized provider detail schema including name, taxonomy, status, and practice locations.

FEAT-4-STORY-14.title: Construct External Provider Links (State Boards and Research)
FEAT-4-STORY-14.description: Generate external URLs for provider verification including state medical board lookup links and research site URLs based on provider metadata.

FEAT-4-STORY-15.title: Integrate URL Validation for External Links
FEAT-4-STORY-15.description: Validate constructed external links using URL guardian to ensure links are reachable, safe, and properly formatted before returning to the client.

FEAT-4-STORY-16.title: Error Handling and Fallback Logic for Provider Lookup
FEAT-4-STORY-16.description: Implement robust error handling for NPI API failures, missing provider data, and partial responses, returning safe fallback responses to the facade.
